messages:
Carla (AcmeOps): Hi team — before POC kickoff we need to confirm SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning, RBAC mappings, domain verification flow, and costs for Dedicated POC. Also legal wants DPA/SOC2. Target kickoff next Tue.
Ana (AE): Thanks Carla — we can cover SAML and SCIM. Sam, can you confirm attribute mapping and whether group assertions are OK?
Sam (SE): Yup. We support both IdP group assertions and SCIM group sync. Typical mappings:
- email -> userName
- givenName / familyName -> name.givenName / name.familyName
- groups -> groups
Example SCIM payload snippet for provisioning test account:
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.cust@acme.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "John", "familyName": "Cust"},
  "emails": [{"value": "j.cust@acme.com", "primary": true}]
}
```
Mike (Sales-Eng): For RBAC we can map SAML group claims to our role names. Example: `group:acme-admins -> role:org_admin`, `group:acme-devs -> role:developer`. We also support SCIM Group resources for provisioning team structure.
Priya (Security): On legal/Security side: we can provide SOC2 Type II report + DPA template. If they need on-prem HSM/KMS integration that's additional engineering work and longer lead time.
Jordan (Security): Domain verification options: 1) Verify via SAML NameID or email domain + 2) DNS TXT verification for org-level ownership. If ACME wants to restrict sign-ins to verified domains only we can enforce that in the tenant config.
Carla (AcmeOps): Good. For the Dedicated POC pricing — can you confirm whether billing is per-seat, per-token, or flat capacity? We need predictable numbers for procurement.
Ana (AE): For short POCs we usually do a flat POC capacity fee + usage cap. Example: 4-week Dedicated POC = flat $5k + overage billed by token if they exceed agreed cap. We can also do a time-limited hosted tier credit if they prefer variable usage.
Mike (Sales-Eng): I'll draft a formal SOW with capacity, expected qps, and overage rates. Also note: we can disable data retention for POC tenant if required (data isolation option).
Sam (SE): Next steps from technical side:
1) Carla to share IdP metadata (SAML XML) and an SCIM test account.
2) We'll provide SP metadata (ACS URL, EntityID). Example:
```
ACS: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs
EntityID: https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata
```
3) We'll run a provisioning smoke test and share logs.
Carla (AcmeOps): I'll upload metadata to the shared folder and book the preflight call for tomorrow 10am PT.
Priya (Security): Please have your legal point of contact ready. We'll send DPA + SOC2 link. If they want encryption-at-rest proof we can provide KMS diagrams.
Carla (AcmeOps): Noted. One blocker: procurement needs a billing contact and a purchase order before the POC invoice. Ana, can you handle?
Ana (AE): Yep — will loop in finance and send contact details today.
deploy-bot: New tenant created for POC: tenant-acme-poc-id=tr_abc123 (pending provisioning).
Sam (SE): I will start config once I have metadata and the test user. Will post progress here.
Carla (AcmeOps): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. See you on the preflight call.
Ana (AE): Thanks — I'll follow up with SOW and PO instructions after the call. :thumbsup:
